subject: gov.policy
name: Plan Strategique Numerique 2023-2028
milestone: Standing national digital strategy
position_end: In force; no published implementation report held

subject: gov.policy
name: Technical Assistance Facility for the Refondation
milestone: Launched at the Palais d'Etat d'Iavoloha, running 2026 to 2030 with UNDP support
position_end: Launched; 170 focal points certified and proposals submitted through a dedicated platform by end-July 2026 (2026-07)
note: Interventions selected by a steering committee run three to nine months.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybercrime bill overhauling the 2014 law
milestone: Tabled in the National Assembly 2026-08-31
position_end: the bill before the National Assembly, carrying prison terms of two to ten years and providing for a new digital protection and investigation unit
note: no revised text, promulgation date or parliamentary timetable is held for the bill

subject: gov.legislate
name: Dedicated social-media law
milestone: Announced by the minister of communication, covering harassment, defamation and disinformation
position_end: Announced; no draft held (2026-06)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Digital bills before the extraordinary session
milestone: Extraordinary session opened 25 August 2026
position_end: Three of the seven bills on the order paper of the extraordinary session opened on 25 August 2026 are digital: bill 040/2026 on electronic communication and digital infrastructure, tabled 21 July 2026; bill 042/2026, a complete recasting of the 2014 cybercrime law, tabled 7 July 2026; and bill 043/2026, tabled 4 August 2026, authorising ratification of the United Nations Convention against Cybercrime adopted at Hanoi on 25 October 2025
note: no bill texts are on file

subject: gov.legislate
name: Electronic signature and interoperability decree
milestone: Draft regulatory framework validated at a ministry workshop
position_start: The 2015 electronic-signature law without an implementing decree
position_end: Draft decree validated and not adopted; a national interoperability committee provided for (2025-09)
note: The minister named the recasting as a contribution to a future digital code, which is not held.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Order to block pornographic sites at internet service provider level
milestone: Decision of the Council of Ministers, 8 July 2026, on public-order grounds
position_end: In force as a cabinet decision; no timetable, technical mechanism, named regulator or appeal route specified (2026-07)

subject: gov.protect
name: Commission Malagasy de l'Informatique et des Libertes (CMIL)
milestone: Provided for by loi n 2014-038 and not constituted; creation urged by an assessment mission
position_end: Provided for, not constituted; no later account held

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection law (loi n 2014-038)
milestone: In force since 9 January 2015
position_end: In force, unenforced
note: The law excludes part of journalistic practice from its scope.

subject: gov.protect
name: United States bilateral health agreement and its data-sharing agreement
note: A federal complaint filed 2026-04-02 records that the State Department entered into dozens of bilateral health agreements between December 2025 and February 2026, each typically a memorandum plus at least one further agreement on data sharing, that a FOIA request of 2025-12-24 covers the Madagascar agreements, and that the department published a subset of the memoranda in March 2026 and then withdrew public access; no text, signature date or party for Madagascar is held

subject: gov.regional
name: China-initiated international network against cybercrime
milestone: Council of Ministers approved accession 2026-08-04
position_end: Accession approved by the Council of Ministers on 4 August 2026, mobilising the foreign affairs, justice, public-security, digital-development and gendarmerie ministries for cross-border cooperation on online fraud
note: no founding text, membership list, data-sharing rule or safeguard on what is exchanged is held

subject: gov.regional
name: Regional public service assembly participation
milestone: Assembly attended 2026-08-31
position_end: Madagascar arguing at the regional public service annual general assembly for an administration turned towards citizens

subject: gov.regional
name: United Nations Convention against Cybercrime
milestone: Signature reported 2026-08-15
position_end: Signed, on the account of 2026-08-15, with no ratification instrument, parliamentary submission or implementing legislation on record
note: the signature is reported rather than evidenced by a depositary record

subject: gov.standards
name: Mobile money open API conformance
milestone: MVola documented as conforming to the GSMA Mobile Money API
position_end: Conformant
sources: 2025-03-31 MVola Madagascar - A case study for the GSMA Mobile Money API and open platforms

subject: gov.discourse
name: Civil-society or parliamentary record on digital governance
milestone: No civil-society, parliamentary or press-freedom account of Madagascar's digital governance is held
position_end: Not held

subject: finance.budget
name: Domestic budget appropriation for digital transformation
milestone: No loi de finances, annex or appropriation line for the digital ministry, the Digital Governance Unit or the identity office is held
position_end: Not held

subject: finance.new
name: Airtel Mobile Commerce guarantee (MIGA)
milestone: US$5,130,000 committed
position_end: Committed; no implementation record held

subject: finance.new
name: Digital Governance and Identification Management System project (World Bank)
milestone: US$143,000,000 committed
position_end: Committed; closed 30 June 2026 with the identity component continuing

subject: finance.new
name: Financial Inclusion Project (World Bank)
milestone: Committed, and restructured in October 2021
position_end: Committed and restructured; no later implementation record held
sources: 2018-02-28-world-bank-mdg-2018-madagascar-financial-inclusion-bw01|2021-10-13 Madagascar Financial Inclusion Project - Restructuring Paper (P161491, World Bank)

subject: finance.new
name: Governance digitisation project (African Development Bank)
milestone: Committed
position_end: Committed; no implementation record held

subject: finance.new
name: Telecommunications modernisation loan (China Eximbank)
milestone: US$54,708,617 committed on a concessional loan of RMB 337.9m
position_end: Committed; no implementation record held
note: Year precision; the loan is denominated in renminbi by the financier and the USD figure is a capture conversion.

subject: finance.new
name: WeLight solar mini-grid and rural electrification (Norfund)
milestone: US$17,067,987 committed
position_end: Committed; no implementation record held

subject: infra.connect
name: 5G-Advanced trial (Yas and Huawei)
milestone: Trial run at the operator's Andraharo campus, 23 July 2026
position_end: Trial run; no commercial 5G service on record (2026-07)
note: The operator claims to be the fourth in the world to test the technology; the claim is its own.

subject: infra.connect
name: Airtel and Eutelsat OneWeb rural broadband
milestone: Low-earth-orbit rural broadband partnership deepened
position_end: Partnership deepened; no rural site count or subscriber figure published (2026-06)

subject: infra.connect
name: Antananarivo-Mahajanga fibre backbone (Orange)
milestone: 558 km backbone inaugurated after eight months' construction
position_end: 558 km in service, built by the country's third fibre operator (2025-12)

subject: infra.connect
name: AXIAN 4G and 5G expansion programme
milestone: European Investment Bank lent US$100m under Global Gateway, US$40m of it to Madagascar
position_start: US$82m of the operator's own investment and a US$100m EIB loan committed (2025-04)
position_end: Unchanged; no coverage or site figure published since

subject: infra.connect
name: DARE1 subsea cable extension to Madagascar
milestone: Extension to Mahajanga and Toliara announced; work from 2026, ready for service 2028
position_end: Extension announced on a 3,200-3,500 km leg via Tanzania and Mozambique, ready for service 2028

subject: infra.connect
name: Digital and Energy Connectivity for Inclusion project (DECIM)
milestone: Supervision aide-memoire records US$375m, of which US$135m for digital
position_start: US$375m envelope with the rural-connectivity tender document due end-October 2025
position_end: Tender document slipped to January 2026; 664,000 devices distributed by the June 2026 review
note: The Board approved US$400,000,000 on 30 March 2023; a 2024 restructuring partially cancelled financing. All amounts are the World Bank's own and in USD.

subject: infra.connect
name: Satellite connectivity for ten enclaved zones (DECIM)
milestone: Arrangement to connect ten enclaved zones discussed with SpaceX
position_end: Announced, nothing connected; no site or date published

subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink Direct-to-Cell service
milestone: First Direct-to-Cell trial run at Sadabe, 11 July 2026
position_end: First trial run on Airtel spectrum, the third African country to do so; commercial launch pending the regulator (2026-07)

subject: infra.store
name: National data centres (Tsimbazaza and Iavoloha)
milestone: Two renewable-powered centres confirmed at the World Bank portfolio review of 24 June 2026
position_start: Tenders opened for rehabilitation of the main data centre and the identity-card personalisation centre (2025-12)
position_end: Two renewable-powered centres confirmed as securing the identity system; no commissioning date published (2026-06)

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National cybersecurity strategy
milestone: Multisectoral strategy launched at a workshop with a three-month delivery target
position_end: Launched with a three-month delivery target; no strategy document published (2026-08)
note: Financed through PRODIGY; members of parliament flagged the 2014 cyber law as needing an update.

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Rahaka national interoperability platform
milestone: National interoperability launched, with an online one-stop window announced
position_end: Operational at the investment board, the social-security fund, the statistics institute, the justice ministry and the tax directorate (2026-04)
sources: 2026-04-29-guichet-unique-en-ligne-interoperabilite-rahaka-lexpress|2025-08-28 Madagascar seeks firm to expand digital interoperability platform
note: Built on X-Road and operated by the Digital Governance Unit with PRODIGY support.

subject: dpi.id
name: Biometric enrolment kits and centres
milestone: Steering committee validated the proof of concept, releasing 2,500 kits nationwide
position_end: 2,500 kits across 1,729 centres, six days a week; the January pilot enrolled about 130,000 across 116 centres in 26 communes (2026-04)
note: The pilot ran through regime change, civil unrest and a cyclone; the completeness and availability figures are the vendor's.

subject: dpi.id
name: PRODIGY biometric national identity enrolment
milestone: First adult phase enrolled more than six million people against a two-million target
position_start: Vendors contracted, no enrolment under way (2025-05)
position_end: More than six million adults enrolled in the April to June 2026 phase; a second phase in preparation (2026-07)
note: Enrolment counts are reported on different scopes and dates: 2.6m in two months, 3.25m adults, over 5.6m total, and over 6m for the phase. No cost figure for either phase is reported.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Airtel Money and Baobab Bank integration
milestone: Baobab Bank integrated into Airtel's mobile banking service
position_end: Bidirectional wallet-to-account transfers over USSD and the bank's application (2026-07)

subject: dpi.pay
name: AXIAN Digibank and Fintech
milestone: Fintech cluster rebranded, evolving MVola and Mixx toward a full digital bank
position_end: Digital-bank strategy announced across five markets, serving about 500,000 merchants a month (2025-11)

subject: dpi.pay
name: e-Ariary central bank digital currency
milestone: eCurrency's DSC3 platform selected for the pilot
position_end: Vendor selected; the central bank sole issuer with private distribution, and no live pilot reported (2025-10)
sources: 2025-10-29-ecurrency-dsc3-eariary-cbdc-partner-prnewswire|2025-05-28 Madagascar Tests e-Ariary, Its Central Bank Digital Currency, to Modernize Payments

subject: dpi.pay
name: MVola mobile money platform
milestone: Core platform replaced in May 2026
position_start: In service on the previous core platform
position_end: Migrated to a new core platform; May and June 2026 outages and balance-display faults reported and stated by the operator as regularised (2026-08)
note: The account is the operator's alone, given to a newspaper three months after the fact. No regulator is named, no incident report is published and no compensation is mentioned.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Orange Money Pro
milestone: Business transactions application launched
position_end: In service; no take-up figures published
sources: 2025-03-19 Madagascar - Orange Launches Mobile App (Orange Money Pro) for Business Transactions

subject: dpi.registry
name: Civil registry and database management contract (IN Groupe)
milestone: EUR 8.5m contract awarded
position_end: Awarded; no delivery milestone published

subject: dpi.registry
name: Civil-record digitisation
milestone: About 10 million civil records digitised across 1,695 communes with optical character recognition and AI indexing
position_end: About 10 million records digitised using mobile satellite and solar units (2026-05)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Electoral roll reconstitution
milestone: Full reconstitution opened at Talata Volonondry, running four months to 24 November 2026
position_end: Full reconstitution under way through five registration channels, gated on presentation of a national identity card (2026-07)
note: The commission states that an unregistered citizen may not observe polling in their own place of residence nor lodge a complaint or contest results.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Mass birth-registration law
milestone: Law of 28 May 2026 allowing births to be registered en masse within the enrolment operation
position_start: Late birth registration only through a costly judicial process
position_end: Mass registration permitted within enrolment, with over 2,000 teams and more than 19,000 fokontany chiefs confirming identities against a de-duplicated database (2026-05)
note: About six million adults, roughly 40%, lacked a birth certificate.

subject: dpi.mis
name: Digital health maturity score
milestone: Assessment result reported, August 2026
position_end: A digital-health maturity score of 55.6 per cent following assessment
note: The assessment instrument and who administered it are not named in the account.

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Development fund human-resources ERP
milestone: Consultancy tender issued, bids due 2026-08-26
position_end: Out to tender: the social-protection fund is recruiting a consultancy to build a human-resources management ERP under a World Bank-financed social safety nets and resilience project, with bids due 26 August 2026
note: no contract value, scope or delivery date is disclosed; the same fund separately tendered for a payroll server under a World Bank contingent emergency response project on 2026-08-07

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Higher-education accreditation platform
milestone: Presented at the ministry on 3 August 2026
position_end: In service; 546 applications received as at 10 July 2026, of which about 250 expected at the session opening 21 September 2026

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Maritime Single Window
milestone: Indonesian financing of about 816m ariary confirmed 2026-08-07
position_end: Being deployed as a platform centralising port administrative procedures, financed by Indonesia's international development agency at more than 3.4bn Indonesian rupiah, about 816m ariary, through the port, maritime and river agency, and announced at the launch of a bilateral cooperation programme
note: no go-live date, port coverage, operator or procedure list is stated

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Police reporting platform for violence and disappearances
milestone: Presented at Anosy on 28 July 2026 by the minister of public security
position_end: In service 24 hours a day on web and an Android application in Malagasy and French, with anonymous filing and a citizen-visible reference number (2026-07)
note: Built by the national police's own information-systems directorate; no data controller, retention rule, deletion route or supervisory authority is named.

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Public procurement of computing equipment and networks
milestone: Tenders opened 2026-08-29
position_end: two tenders opened by the development intervention fund for computing equipment and for the equipment to build a computer network

subject: digital.localgov
name: Municipal or communal digital service delivery
milestone: Civil registration reaches the commune and fokontany level through national programmes; no municipal digital-service system or mandate is held
position_end: Not held

subject: tech.ai
name: ATLAS Umoja African-language AI partnership
milestone: AXIAN Telecom named a founding partner
position_end: Founding partnership announced; no Malagasy-language model or dataset released (2026-07)

subject: tech.ai
name: Customs data and artificial-intelligence centre (CEDIA)
milestone: Launched within the customs administration in May 2025
position_start: In operation, with the Enhanced Risk Assessment targeting system and a data warehouse
position_end: In operation; no later account or performance figure held
note: The IMF selected the administration as its African pilot for AI in customs operations in 2025.

subject: tech.ai
name: Madagascar-Egypt partnership on AI in public administration
milestone: Reported by the press with no signature date given
position_end: Reported; no date of signature, text or figure (2026-08)

subject: tech.ai
name: National artificial-intelligence strategy
milestone: Applied AI is in service in customs and civil-record digitisation; no national AI strategy, policy or governing instrument is held
position_end: Not held

subject: tech.ai
name: World AI Cooperation Organization membership
milestone: Accession reported 2026-08-15
position_end: Joined, on the account of 2026-08-15, alongside revision of the cybercrime law and signature of the United Nations cybercrime convention; the country still holds no national artificial-intelligence strategy
note: no accession instrument, obligation or contribution is held

subject: tech.innovate
name: Digital entrepreneurship environment
position_end: Placed behind regional comparators on the 2025 VIGS index reported by UNDP (2025-12)
note: A reference index reported at second hand; carried as a dated citation, not as current state.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital literacy programme or measurement
milestone: Basic digital literacy is named inside a donor sub-component; no standalone programme document or published measurement is held
position_end: Not held

subject: capacity.training
name: DECIM digital skills sub-component
milestone: US$15m sub-component covering a virtual university, advanced skills training and the national research network
position_end: US$15m committed, with 5,700 people to be trained in advanced digital skills and US$2.4m for the national research network (2025-11)

subject: capacity.training
name: Ministry recruitment of specialist digital posts
milestone: 259 applications received for ten established civil-service posts
position_end: 259 applications received by 1 August 2026 for posts in artificial intelligence, data management, digital innovation, cybersecurity, telecommunications and digital law; no appointment announced
note: Applicants have publicly asked for integrity guarantees on the selection.

subject: capacity.research
name: UNIPOD university connectivity and AI initiative
milestone: Initiative to bring high-speed internet and artificial intelligence to universities
position_end: Announced; no campus connected or facility opened on record (2026-01)

subject: include.access
name: Active mobile money users
position_end: Six to seven million active users against a population of about thirty million (2026-08)
note: The operator's figure for the whole market. It is not comparable with the 73% MVola usage in the 2025 Visa study, which measured awareness and use rather than active accounts.

subject: include.access
name: Fonds DECIM affordable-device facility
milestone: Nine applications approved and in contractualisation; a US$2.5m first call for funds made on 7 November 2025
position_start: April 2025 call for applications closed, none contracted
position_end: Nine applications approved, with only two operator contracts unsigned; a student-laptop pilot proposed for about 700 computers (2025-11)
note: US$24m sub-component of DECIM, managed by BAMBOO; 664,000 devices distributed by June 2026.

subject: include.access
name: Mobile internet tariff reduction agreement
milestone: Operators agreed to cut prices gradually, with excise-duty relief conditioned on reinvestment in quality
position_start: A standoff between the state and the operators
position_end: Agreement reached; no price schedule or reduction figure published (2025-12)

subject: data.statistics
name: INSTAT microdata sharing platform
milestone: Login and registration platform captured 9 August 2026, advertising census and survey microdata
position_end: Registration-gated platform at microdata.instat.mg advertising ERISC household surveys 2020-2022, an ERISC enterprise survey and RGPH 3 census microdata; no dataset documentation, sample size, licence or reuse terms established beyond the landing page (2026-08)
note: Datasets themselves are behind account registration and were not retrieved.

subject: data.open
name: Assemblee nationale open-data portal
milestone: Read-only REST API and open-data pages captured 9 August 2026, publishing five parliamentary datasets under an explicit reuse licence
position_end: Live REST API serving five datasets (deputies, legislative texts, sittings, committees, parliamentary groups) as JSON and CSV, rate-limited to 60 requests a minute, under Licence Ouverte v2.0 (CC-BY compatible); page counters read 163 deputies, 45 texts and 128 sittings (2026-08-09)
note: Supported by EISA; the page carries no date of its own so the capture date stands as as_at.

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal or policy
milestone: Three of four known Malagasy open-data platforms captured 9 August 2026; no coordinated national open-data policy found
position_start: No portal, open-data policy or public-sector information reuse instrument held
position_end: Institution-specific resources confirmed: a licensed parliamentary open-data API, a gated national-statistics microdata platform and an unconfirmed general portal (opendata.mg); the finance ministry's own portal does not resolve; no whole-of-government open-data policy or mandate is held (2026-08)
note: PortES, the finance ministry's own portal (portes.mef.gov.mg), does not resolve (NXDOMAIN, 2026-08-09).

subject: data.open
name: OpenData Madagascar portal (opendata.mg)
status: In development, no datasets or issuing institution confirmed
milestone: Landing page captured 9 August 2026, naming no issuing institution or linked dataset
position_end: Reachable landing page with six undated category tiles (Entreprise, Gouvernement, Education, Environnement, eCommerce, Sante) and four unlinked project cards; no issuing institution, dataset count or licence stated (2026-08)
note: Footer credits only a private vendor (Radias IT); not established as a government portal. One of four Malagasy open-data platforms tested 2026-08-09.

milestone: Satellite connectivity partnerships are held; no earth-observation or geospatial-data programme, mandate or output is
position_end: Not held

milestone: No India-Madagascar digital cooperation agreement, line of credit or programme document is held
